name: TIS steel sections (Thailand)
summary: Thai standard steel sections: H-beams, channels, angles (TIS 1227), light lip channels (TIS 1228) and structural tubes (TIS 107).
description: 157 profiles by their nominal dimensions, shown under the standard TIS. Lapin works out the areas, masses and section properties. The dimensions are indicative: check them against your mill's table (SYS, TATA, etc.) before design.
